def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    bg = grid[0][0]

    # The guide's main connected stroke makes an elbow: down column 2,
    # then right along row 2. Put panel 2 on the southwest side and
    # panel 3 on the northeast side.
    p2 = [[grid[r + 1][7 + c] for c in range(5)] for r in range(5)]
    p3 = [[grid[r + 1][13 + c] for c in range(5)] for r in range(5)]

    col2 = next((v for row in p2 for v in row if v != bg), bg)
    col3 = next((v for row in p3 for v in row if v != bg), bg)

    for r in range(5):
        for c in range(5):
            # Southwest side of the elbow belongs to panel 2; northeast
            # side belongs to panel 3. The stroke itself is the boundary.
            if r > 2 or (r < 2 and c < 2) or (r == 2 and c < 2):
                value = col2 if p2[r][c] != bg else bg
            else:
                value = col3 if p3[r][c] != bg else bg
            out[r + 1][19 + c] = value

    return out
```

def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]

    # The interior background is the most common color in a pattern panel.
    vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(1, 6) for c in range(1, 6)]
    bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)

    p2 = [[grid[r][7 + c] for c in range(5)] for r in range(1, 6)]
    p3 = [[grid[r][13 + c] for c in range(5)] for r in range(1, 6)]

    # The guide forms an L with its indicator in the upper-right corner.
    # Keep the third pattern outside that indicated corner; the second
    # pattern is copied in full and has priority where they overlap.
    for r in range(5):
        for c in range(5):
            v2 = p2[r][c]
            keep3 = (r >= 2 or c <= 2)
            v3 = p3[r][c] if keep3 else bg
            out[r + 1][19 + c] = v2 if v2 != bg else v3

    return out
```
